verdict.rationale: The evidence shows customizable reports with filters, custom dashboards for teams, and granular reporting permissions. That loosely approximates filtered, shared views, but at the reporting layer rather than as saved record views. Custom data structures appear only as custom objects created and managed through a developer API, which is not self-serve field creation by an ops user. Missing for 10: no-code custom field/property creation by non-admins, saved record list views with filters and sorting, sorting of any kind, explicit view-sharing controls for record views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
